text:
Predicates:
EasternWT(x) ::: x is an Eastern wild turkey.
OsceolaWT(x) ::: x is an Osceola wild turkey.
GouldWT(x) ::: x is a Gould’s wild turkey.
MerriamsWT(x) ::: x is Merriam’s wild turkey.
RioGrandeWT(x) ::: x is Rio Grande wild turkey.
OcellatedWT(x) ::: x is Ocellated wild turkey.
WildTurkey(x) ::: x is a wild turkey.
Tom ::: a specific individual named Tom.

Premises:
¬EasternWT(Tom) ::: Tom is not an Eastern wild turkey.
¬OsceolaWT(Tom) ::: Tom is not an Osceola wild turkey.
¬(GouldWT(Tom) ∨ MerriamsWT(Tom) ∨ RioGrandeWT(Tom)) ::: Tom is not a Gould’s, Merriam’s, or Rio Grande wild turkey.
WildTurkey(Tom) ::: Tom is a wild turkey.

Conclusion:
OcellatedWT(Tom) ::: Tom is an Ocellated wild turkey.
